name: empty_file
note: Zero lines, not one empty line.

name: one_terminator
note: A trailing terminator does NOT create a phantom final line. This is the rule no hash vector can catch.

name: two_terminators
note: Only ONE trailing terminator is removed, so the blank line before it survives as a line.

name: lone_cr
note: A bare CR is a terminator, not content.

name: leading_bom
note: A leading U+FEFF is stripped before splitting.

name: interior_bom_is_content
note: U+FEFF anywhere but the start is content.

name: blank_lines_preserved_as_lines
note: Splitting keeps blank lines; discarding them is section 7's job, not section 4's.

name: whitespace_only_line_is_a_line
note: Section 4 does not normalise; the whitespace-only line survives splitting intact.
